title: Predict, Prevent, and Evaluate: Disentangled Text-Driven Image Manipulation Empowered by Pre-Trained Vision-Language Model

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the unintended change or entanglement of skin-tone attributes (e.g., tracking the CLIP distance of 'white skin') when performing orthogonal text-driven image manipulations (e.g., adding 'grey hair' or 'blue eyes').
Measuring the unintended change or entanglement of gender attributes (e.g., tracking the CLIP distance of 'male') when applying unrelated image manipulations (e.g., adding 'with wrinkles').
